    MORE PROFESSIONAL WORK

    Inside my work at Contiloe.

    Explore 8 projects

    ScriptAI · AI Writers’ Room

    A writing workflow from research and story structure to screenplay and concept art.

    A Flask portal coordinates research, structure, story, beats, scene order, screenplay, checks, and concept art. Three human approval gates control progression, and rewrite notes rerun the relevant stages.

    Hybrid vector and full-text retrieval grounds sourced stories in a mythology vault. Continuity checks track characters, geography, timing, and source provenance.

    Helps writers develop and revise material while keeping editorial decisions and approvals in their hands.

    Python · Flask · PostgreSQL / pgvector · Claude

    Outreach Agent · IP Licensing

    Research buyers, match content rights, and prepare outreach drafts for review.

    A four-step pipeline finds buyers, researches dated news signals, matches catalogue titles, and prepares personalized drafts. Python checks remove unverified contacts and unsupported personalization.

    Human review precedes sending. An approval page supports editing and SMTP delivery, with send records to prevent duplicates.

    Gives the licensing team relevant buyer research and reviewable outreach in one workflow.

    Python · Claude · Apollo · SMTP

    Production Partner Agent · Studio Sales

    Find production companies with active studio needs and prepare tailored pitches.

    Research checks studio fit and live projects before contact enrichment. News signals and capability matching select relevant studio features for the pitch.

    The pipeline produces email or LinkedIn drafts and a review digest. Team members send selected outreach manually.

    Helps the sales team prioritize companies with a concrete studio requirement and a relevant reason to engage.

    Python · Claude · Apollo · Research and scoring pipelines

    Studio Marketing Agent · Film & Wedding Campaigns

    Segment audiences and prepare email and WhatsApp campaigns.

    Deterministic Python workflows merge audience lists, reuse contacts, optionally enrich missing emails, and generate drafts from fixed templates. Wedding vendors are mapped to eight template segments.

    Selected drafts can be sent by email or the WhatsApp Cloud API. Checks block unfilled placeholders and repeat sends.

    Reduces campaign preparation work while keeping audience, message, and sending choices explicit.

    Python · Mail merge · Apollo · SMTP · Meta WhatsApp Cloud API

    AI Studio & Studio Websites

    Present studio capabilities and route enquiries to the appropriate team.

    Built two static websites with JavaScript-driven content, PHP enquiry handling, and Microsoft 365 mail routing. Added input validation, spam checks, structured data, and sitemaps.

    An in-browser semantic FAQ assistant matches questions to prepared answers, with keyword fallback.

    Lets visitors explore the studios and find relevant information before making an enquiry.

    HTML / CSS / JavaScript · Python build scripts · PHP · Microsoft Graph

    Finance AI · Invoice & Budget Workflows

    Take bills through extraction, validation, approvals, and Tally voucher export.

    A FastAPI backend and Next.js frontend coordinate document intake, AI extraction and classification, rule-based checks, duplicate detection, and two-stage approval by different people.

    The budget module imports show budgets and daily shoot reports for budget-versus-actual comparisons. Approved records generate balanced purchase and sales voucher XML for import into Tally.

    Brings bill review, budget visibility, and approval history into a traceable workflow.

    FastAPI · PostgreSQL · Next.js · Claude · Tally XML

    Contiloe Pictures Website

    Rebuild the company website with structured content and a migration plan.

    Python build scripts generate nine pages, a sitemap, and search indexing files. JavaScript renders shows, films, archive content, and the company timeline.

    Includes enquiry routing, an in-browser FAQ assistant, and permanent redirects from legacy WordPress URLs.

    Organizes the company’s work for visitors and prepares existing links for the website migration.

    Python · HTML / JavaScript · PHP · Microsoft 365

    VideoEditAI · Genre Editing Agent

    A prototype for genre-aware cuts and editable timeline exports.

    The prototype analyzes clip metadata and camera motion, builds an edit decision list, and renders through FFmpeg. Genre rulebooks guide pacing, transitions, and sound.

    Synthetic-footage tests exercise the rules-based planner.

    Explores a workflow for generating alternate cuts and handing timelines to editors in DaVinci Resolve or Premiere.

    Python · OpenCV · FFmpeg · OpenTimelineIO · Claude
